newsitem.title: INDIA: Tribal rebels fire on Indian wedding, killing 11.
newsitem.headline: Tribal rebels fire on Indian wedding, killing 11.

text.p: Tribal separatists shot 11 people dead, including two children, and injured several others in a marriage party in the Kokrajhar district of India's northeastern state of Assam on Tuesday, police said.
A state police spokesman told Reuters that separatists of the Bodo Security Force (BSF) fired indiscriminately on the marriage party in Gossaigaon.
No further details were available, he said.
At least nine people were killed by the separatists last week, police said.
The BSF, which is comprised of Bodo tribesmen, is fighting for a separate homeland in Assam state.
